import re,sys
# 复现：TurnCancelled 不推进 branch head 之后，所有"回填 head 节点 turn_id"的点都写到上一轮节点
p='crates/pony-agent-core/src/agent/session/store.rs'
s=open(p).read()
prem={
 'head-not-advanced': r'let advances_branch_head = !matches!\(kind, HistoryNodeKind::TurnCancelled\);',
 'finalize-writes-turn-id-into-head': r'node\.turn_id = Some\(_turn_id\.to_string\(\)\);',      # store.rs:2540
 'sync/persist-recompute-from-trace-tail': r'node\.turn_id = node\s*\.turn_trace_history\s*\.last\(\)',  # store.rs:3792 / 4053
}
for name,pat in prem.items():
    if not re.search(pat,s,re.S):
        print('[STALE premise]',name); sys.exit(2)
nodes=[{'id':'node-1','kind':'TurnCommitted','turn_id':'turn-1'}]
head='node-1'                                    # branch head 停在上一轮（store.rs:3738 不推进）
nodes.append({'id':'node-2','kind':'TurnCancelled','turn_id':'turn-2'})
for n in nodes:                                  # 终态 flush -> commit_event_batch -> finalize_event_watermark(session,'turn-2')
    if n['id']==head: n['turn_id']='turn-2'
hits=[n['id'] for n in nodes if n['turn_id']=='turn-2']
print('nodes after cancel + terminal flush:',nodes)
assert len(hits)==1, f'C2 violated: turn-2 held by {len(hits)} nodes {hits}'
PY

s=open('crates/pony-agent-core/src/agent/runtime/turn_stream.rs').read()
pre=s.index('macro_rules! stream_tool_call_pre'); post=s.index('macro_rules! stream_tool_call_post')
post_end=s.index('loop {',post)
if s.count('pending_calls_after_batch_index(&current_tool_calls, executed_calls.len() + 1)')!=2:
    print('[STALE premise]'); raise SystemExit(2)
if 'executed_calls.push(current_tool_call.clone());' not in s[post:post_end]:
    print('[STALE premise] push 不在 post 阶段'); raise SystemExit(2)
if 'executed_calls.clear();' not in s[post_end:post_end+400]:
    print('[STALE premise] clear 不在 hop 循环头'); raise SystemExit(2)
calls=['Read','Bash','Write']     # 一个 hop 宣告 3 个调用（串行段：段 k == 单调用 k）
executed=['Read']                 # 调用 0 已完全收尾并 push；预阶段进入调用 1 时取消
i=len(executed)                   # 当前调用 calls[1]=Bash，**尚未执行**
pending=calls[len(executed)+1:]   # 代码：start_index = executed_calls.len()+1 = 2
print('declared =',calls,'| cancel in pre-phase of',calls[i],'| executed =',executed,'| pending =',pending)
missing=[c for c in calls[i:] if c not in pending]
assert not missing, f'{missing} 已宣告但未执行，既不在 pending 也不在 tool_activities（静默消失）'

s=open('crates/pony-agent-core/src/agent/runtime/turn_persist.rs').read()
for pat in ['let transcript = closure.or(legacy_transcript);','TOOL_RESULT_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS: usize = 240']:
    if pat not in s:
        print('[STALE premise]',pat); raise SystemExit(2)
def summarize(raw):
    c=' '.join(raw.split())
    return c if len(c)<=240 else c[:239]+'\u2026'
real='X'*400+'SENTINEL_RESULT'          # 真实 tool 结果（legacy hop_records 里逐字存在）
closed=[{'name':'Read','result_summary':summarize(real)}]
closure=[{'role':'tool','content':closed[0]['result_summary']}]  # closed_steps 非空 ⇒ closure=Some
legacy=[{'role':'tool','content':real}]                          # 被 closure.or() 丢弃
final=closure if closure else legacy
ok=any('SENTINEL_RESULT' in m['content'] for m in final)
print('summary len =',len(closed[0]['result_summary']),'| sentinel kept =',ok)
assert ok, '真实结果尾部被 240 字符截断（真实 hop 往返被合成 closure 覆盖）'
